NSIS UAC plug-in, copyright (C) 2007 Anders Kjersem.
https://nsis.sourceforge.io/UAC_plug-in

UAC.dll is the unmodified x86 Unicode DLL from electron-builder's original
nsis-resources-3.4.1 release archive.
https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder-binaries/releases/tag/nsis-resources-3.4.1
DLL SHA-256: 2f7f8fc05dc4fd0d5cda501b47e4433357e887bbfed7292c028d99c73b52dc08

UAC.nsh is from app-builder-lib 26.15.6, templates/nsis/include/UAC.nsh.
https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder/blob/electron-builder%4026.15.6/packages/app-builder-lib/templates/nsis/include/UAC.nsh
Header SHA-256: abd701f2898f987041baa9d7ece9d0f8ee806eb5f7d85a4f39b6c60b8d638769
